title: Trigonometry
summary: Grade 10: sine, cosine and tangent, standard angles and identities, and finding heights and distances.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Ratios of sides in right triangles let us measure heights and distances we cannot reach.

factual: What are sin, cos and tan?
What is an angle of elevation?
conceptual: Why do trigonometric ratios depend only on the angle?
debatable: Was the Great Trigonometrical Survey more about science or empire?
